entries.name: fracture.aperture
entries.description: Get/set the fracture aperture.

entries.name: fracture.area
entries.description: Get/set the fracture area.

entries.name: fracture.centerdensity
entries.description: Get the fracture center density.

entries.name: fracture.contact.list
entries.description: Get active contacts associated with a fracture. Iterate over a FISH list using the loop foreach construct.

entries.name: fracture.contact.list.all
entries.description: Get all contacts associated with a fracture. Inactive contacts are included. Iterate over a FISH list using the loop foreach construct.

entries.name: fracture.contactmap
entries.description: Get active contacts associated with a fracture. Iterate over a FISH map using the loop foreach construct.

entries.name: fracture.contactmap.all
entries.description: Get all contacts associated with a fracture. Inactive contacts are included. Iterate over a FISH map using the loop foreach construct.

entries.name: fracture.copy
entries.description: Copy a fracture.

entries.name: fracture.create
entries.description: Create a fracture. The fracture is added to dfn.

entries.name: fracture.ddir
entries.description: Get/set the fracture dip direction.

entries.name: fracture.decimate
entries.description: Get a list of fracture vertex positions. If a disk shaped fracture then the last argument (default 20) is used to decimate the disk shape. Iterate over a FISH list using the loop foreach construct.

entries.name: fracture.delete
entries.description: Delete a fracture. All intersections that refer to this fracture are also deleted.

entries.name: fracture.density
entries.description: Get the fracture mass density.

entries.name: fracture.dfn
entries.description: Get the fracture’s DFN.

entries.name: fracture.diameter
entries.description: Get/set the fracture diameter.

entries.name: fracture.dip
entries.description: Get/set the fracture dip.

entries.name: fracture.extra
entries.description: Get/set a fracture extra variable.

entries.name: fracture.find
entries.description: Find a fracture.

entries.name: fracture.from.contact
entries.description: Create a fracture from a contact. The fracture is added to dfn. The shape is planar and composed of the vertices returned by contact.joint. This can be useful for tracking breakage events.

entries.name: fracture.genpos
entries.description: Get the fracture generation position.

entries.name: fracture.genpos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the fracture generation position.

entries.name: fracture.gensize
entries.description: Get the fracture generation {length in 2D; diameter in 3D}. This corresponds with the fracture size prior to clipping at the tolerance extent.

entries.name: fracture.geomp10
entries.description: Get the P10 of edges.

entries.name: fracture.geomp20
entries.description: Get the P20 of polygons. The P20 is the number of fracture intersections with the geometry polygons per unit area of the geometry polygons. If dfn is not given the calculation is undertaken over all fractures of all DFNs.

entries.name: fracture.geomp21
entries.description: Get the P21 of polygons. The P21 is the cumulative sum of intersection lengths with the geometry polygons per unit area of the geometry polygons. If dfn is not given the calculation is undertaken over all fractures of all DFNs.

entries.name: fracture.geomtrace
entries.description: Get polygon average trace length.

entries.name: fracture.gintersect
entries.description: Get the fracture/geometry intersection status.

entries.name: fracture.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to fracture frac in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: fracture.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the fracture in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: fracture.id
entries.description: Get the fracture ID.

entries.name: fracture.inbox
entries.description: Get fractures intersecting or contained within a box. If dfn is not given the calculation is undertaken over all fractures of all DFNs. Iterate over a FISH array using the loop and array.size constructs.

entries.name: fracture.interarray
entries.description: Get an array of fracture intersections. Iterate over a FISH array using the loop and array.size constructs.

entries.name: fracture.intersect
entries.description: Get the fracture/fracture intersection status.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.end1
entries.description: Get the first fracture in an intersection.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.end2
entries.description: Get the second intersecting object. If the intersection is with a geometry object, then a geometry set pointer is returned.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.find
entries.description: Find a fracture intersection.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.id
entries.description: Get the fracture intersection ID.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.len
entries.description: Get the intersection length.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.list
entries.description: Get the fracture intersection list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum fracture intersection ID.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.npolylinept
entries.description: Get the number of polyline points in an intersection. Polyline intersections may result when intersections between fractures and geometry sets are delineated. See the fracture intersections compute command for further details.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.num
entries.description: Get the number of fracture intersections.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.polylinept
entries.description: Get the position of polyline point i in an intersection. Polyline intersections may result when intersections between fractures and geometry sets are delineated. See the fracture intersections compute command for further details.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.pos1
entries.description: Get the first fracture intersection end position.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.pos1.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of of the first fracture intersection end position.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.pos2
entries.description: Get the second fracture intersection end position.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.pos2.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the second fracture intersection end position.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set
entries.description: Get the intersection set.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set.delete
entries.description: Delete a fracture intersection set. All intersections in this set are deleted.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set.find
entries.description: Find a fracture intersection set.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set.id
entries.description: Get the fracture intersection set ID.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set.interlist
entries.description: Get the fracture intersection list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set.internum
entries.description: Get the number of intersections in the set.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set.list
entries.description: Get the fracture intersection set list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum fracture intersection set ID.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set.name
entries.description: Get the fracture intersection set name.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set.num
entries.description: Get the number of fracture intersection sets.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set.path
entries.description: Get the path between fractures. The fractures connecting frac1 to frac2 are held in the array. Iterate over a FISH array using the loop and array.size constructs.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.set.typeid
entries.description: Get the fracture intersection set type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify fracture intersection set FISH pointers and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: fracture.intersect.typeid
entries.description: Get the fracture intersection type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify fracture intersection FISH pointers and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: fracture.isdisk
entries.description: Get the fracture disk status.

entries.name: fracture.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the fracture and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: fracture.isprop
entries.description: Query the existence of a property.

entries.name: fracture.list
entries.description: Get the global fracture list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: fracture.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum fracture ID.

entries.name: fracture.near
entries.description: Find the closest fracture to a point. If frad is specified, then the search radius is limited. If dfn is not given the calculation is undertaken over all fractures of all DFNs.

entries.name: fracture.normal
entries.description: Get/set the fracture normal.

entries.name: fracture.normal.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the fracture normal.

entries.name: fracture.num
entries.description: Get the total number of fractures.

entries.name: fracture.p10
entries.description: Get the P10 along a transect. The P10 is the number of fracture intersections with a transect per unit length. If dfn is not given then the P10 is calculated over all fractures of all DFNs.

entries.name: fracture.percolation
entries.description: Get the fracture percolation.

entries.name: fracture.pointnear
entries.description: Get the closest point on a fracture.

entries.name: fracture.pos
entries.description: Get/set the fracture position.

entries.name: fracture.pos.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the fracture position.

entries.name: fracture.prop
entries.description: Get/set a fracture property.

entries.name: fracture.template.ddirmax
entries.description: Get/set the maximum dip direction.

entries.name: fracture.template.ddirmin
entries.description: Get/set the minimum dip direction.

entries.name: fracture.template.dipmax
entries.description: Get/set the maximum dip.

entries.name: fracture.template.dipmin
entries.description: Get/set the minimum dip.

entries.name: fracture.template.find
entries.description: Find a DFN template.

entries.name: fracture.template.id
entries.description: Get the DFN template ID.

entries.name: fracture.template.list
entries.description: Get the DFN template list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: fracture.template.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum DFN template ID.

entries.name: fracture.template.name
entries.description: Get the DFN template name.

entries.name: fracture.template.norientparam
entries.description: Get the number of orientation parameters. The parameters can be set with the fracture.template.orientparam intrinsic. See the fracture template create command for further details.

entries.name: fracture.template.nposparam
entries.description: Get the number of position parameters. The parameters can be set with the fracture.template.posparam intrinsic. See the fracture template create command for further details.

entries.name: fracture.template.nsizeparam
entries.description: Get the number of size parameters. The parameters can be set with the fracture.template.sizeparam intrinsic. See the fracture template create command for further details.

entries.name: fracture.template.num
entries.description: Get the number of DFN templates.

entries.name: fracture.template.orientparam
entries.description: Get/set an orientation parameter. The number of parameters can be assessed with the fracture.template.norientparam intrinsic. See the fracture template create command for further details.

entries.name: fracture.template.orienttype
entries.description: Get/set the DFN template orientation type name. Acceptable values are uniform, gauss, powerlaw, bootstrapped, fish, fisher (3D only), and dips (3D only). See the fracture template create command for further details.

entries.name: fracture.template.posparam
entries.description: Get/set a position parameter. The number of parameters can be assessed with the fracture.template.nposparam intrinsic. See the fracture template create command for further details.

entries.name: fracture.template.postype
entries.description: Get/set the DFN template position type name. Acceptable values are uniform, gauss, bootstrapped, and fish. See the fracture template create command for further details.

entries.name: fracture.template.sizemax
entries.description: Get/set the maximum size. The fracture size is defined as the {fracture length in 2D; disk diameter in 3D}.

entries.name: fracture.template.sizemin
entries.description: Get/set the minimum size. The fracture size is defined as the {fracture length in 2D; disk diameter in 3D}.

entries.name: fracture.template.sizeparam
entries.description: Get/set a size parameter. The number of parameters can be assessed with the fracture.template.nsizeparam intrinsic. See the fracture template create command for further details.

entries.name: fracture.template.sizetype
entries.description: Get/set the DFN template size type name. Acceptable values are uniform, gauss, powerlaw, bootstrapped, and fish. See the fracture template create command for further details.

entries.name: fracture.template.typeid
entries.description: Get the DFN template type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify DFN template FISH pointers and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: fracture.typeid
entries.description: Get the fracture type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify fracture FISH pointers and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: fracture.vertex.find
entries.description: Find a fracture vertex.

entries.name: fracture.vertex.list
entries.description: Get the fracture vertex list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: fracture.vertex.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum fracture vertex ID.

entries.name: fracture.vertex.num
entries.description: Get the number of fracture vertices.

entries.name: fracture.vertex.pos
entries.description: Get the fracture vertex position.

entries.name: fracture.vertex.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the fracture vertex position.

entries.name: fracture.vertex.typeid
entries.description: Get the fracture vertex type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify fracture vertex FISH pointers and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: fracture.vertexarray
entries.description: Get an array of fracture vertices. Iterate over a FISH array using the loop and array.size constructs.

entries.name: fracture.vertexlist
entries.description: Get a list of fracture vertices. Iterate over a FISH list using the loop foreach construct.
